description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Lugardra Anslynbel)
- Vendor B (Quoumeans Sosanlu)
- Vendor C (Lutirva Ozhesk)
- Vendor D (Quocas Moumebel)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Lugardra Anslynbel):
  - Vendor A provides on-site staff training
  - Vendor A completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor A charges extra for data migration
  - Vendor A failed a recent security audit
  - Vendor A guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor A quoted a total cost of 376 thousand per year
Vendor B (Quoumeans Sosanlu):
  - Vendor B has unresolved compliance findings
  - Vendor B provides on-site staff training
  - Vendor B allows workflow customisation
  - Vendor B has high engineering staff turnover
  - Vendor B offers 24/7 on-call support
Vendor C (Lutirva Ozhesk):
  - Vendor C passed an independent security audit
  - Vendor C offers straightforward contract exit terms
  - Vendor C supports standard interoperability formats
  - Vendor C provides no staff training
  - Vendor C currently serves 6 hospital clients
Vendor D (Quocas Moumebel):
  - Vendor D does not meet accessibility standards

  - Vendor D allows no customisation
  - Vendor D includes free data migration
  - Vendor D is fully compliant with health-data regulations
